items.text: ETR lists Puka Nacua DOUBTFUL for Sunday; Rapoport confirms not expected to play, with Davante Adams shown he can carry the load. Schefter: McVay says barring setback could return next week vs Eagles.
items.opportunity: Adams high route/target rate historically without Nacua (42% target rate on 142 routes)

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday. Rapoport: good longer-term news but Marcus Mariota starts this week. ETR lists OUT.
items.implication: Mariota start; WAS offense downgrade short-term

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins for Sunday at Indianapolis due to hamstring. Confirmed in Schefter's full OUT list and ETR OUT.
items.implication: Target vacuum in HOU passing game
items.opportunity: Elevated target share for remaining pass-catchers especially TE

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe) for Sunday vs Bengals. Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder). ETR OUT for Dowdle.
items.opportunity: Warren lead + checkdown volume; backups Homer/Heidenreich

items.text: Levitan/ETR projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite QUESTIONABLE tags. Hoping early clarity on Flowers/Mitchell/DJ Moore.
items.implication: Startable if active; DFS implications large
items.opportunity: Warren lead role confirmed via coach; full snaps expected for others

items.text: Broncos: J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams. Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle). ETR lists both IN.
items.implication: DEN backfield full; Coleman out removes stash

items.text: With Dowdle out, Steelers RB coach: Warren will lead the group and get breathers as needed. Levitan: vertical not working for Rodgers so expect zillion checkdowns to Warren; Homer + Heidenreich backups.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + checkdowns; third-down/ dual-threat role

items.text: Berry: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (only 5 games in 3 seasons); pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly into lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.opportunity: Clear lead back role expansion for Hubbard

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Results in two prior Nacua-missed games: 5-35-3 and 8-195-2.
items.implication: Adams WR1 ceiling elevated this week
items.opportunity: High target rate and aDOT/routes when Nacua sidelined

items.text: ETR Week 3 projections live; Jahmyr Gibbs sets new record ceiling projection at 44.0 (avg of top 25th percentile sim outcomes).
items.opportunity: High snap/touch ceiling in Lions offense

items.text: Berry LOVES Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5), Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs poor rush D + high prop

items.text: Berry LOVES Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games, RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush ypg to RBs.
Berry LOVES Chris Olave (double-digit tgts, 53% air yards vs LV high YPR allowed), Christian Watson (WR8 util, 38% RZ share), Dalton Schultz (28% tgt share last week sans Collins; IND soft vs TEs).
items.opportunity: Olave volume; Watson RZ; Schultz elevated with Collins OUT

items.text: Berry HATES Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs) and Travis Etienne (vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara).
items.opportunity: Henderson saw 65% snaps post-Stevenson fumble (Berry 10 Facts)
